blocks.text: Sulfur aam taur par orbitals ke kamzor overlap ki wajah se doosre sulfur atoms ke saath double bonds ke bajaye single bonds banati hai. Nateejatan woh catenation se bare molecules aur banawatein banati hai: S8 taaj (crown) jaisa molecule hai (Figure 12.7). Yeh bonding, aur us ke compounds ki stability, kamre ke darja hararat par sulfur ki kam reactivity ki wajah hai.

blocks.prompt: Kamre ke darja hararat par sulfur khasi ghair-reactive kyun hai (exercise Q.2g)?
blocks.explanation: Sulfur mazboot S-S single bonds se jure mustahkam S8 taaj halqon ke taur par maujood hai; kyunke 3p orbitals pehloo se kamzor overlap karte hain woh oxygen jaise reactive double bonds nahi banati. Halqe torne ko energy chahiye, to sulfur sirf garam karne par react karti hai, jaise jab woh jal kar SO2 banati hai.

items: Sulfur S-S single bonds ko tarjeeh deti hai (kamzor orbital overlap), halqon aur zanjeeron mein catenate hoti hai; S8 taaj jaisa molecule hai; is liye kamre ke darja hararat par kam reactivity.
